title: clang vars
description: Configuration variables for the LLVM Clang C/C++ Compiler recipe

CLANG_VERSION.description: Version of LLVM Clang to install or build.

CLANG_INSTALL_METHOD.description: Installation strategy for Clang ('system' via package manager, 'from-source' compiled from source, 'libscript_native' prebuilt archive, or version managers).

CLANG_PKG_MGR.description: Specific package manager to use when installing Clang (e.g., apt-get, apk, dnf, brew, pacman, winget, choco, scoop, nix, spack).

CLANG_BUILD_TOOLCHAIN.description: Bootstrap C toolchain used when CLANG_INSTALL_METHOD='from-source'.

CLANG_DOWNLOAD_URL.description: Explicit source or binary archive URL for LLVM Clang.

CLANG_USE_LLD.description: Whether to configure LLD as the default linker when using Clang.

CLANG_CFLAGS.description: Default optimization and code generation flags exported when using Clang.
